newsitem.title: USA: CBOT Nov, Jan soybeans drop 30-cent limit on USDA.
newsitem.headline: CBOT Nov, Jan soybeans drop 30-cent limit on USDA.

text.p: CBOT November, January and March soybean contracts dropped the 30-cent-per-bushel daily trading limit as of 1205 CDT on bearish input from the U.S. Agriculture Department's October crop production report, traders said.
USDAy Friday said 1996 U.S. soybean production totaled 2.346 billion bushels, above an average trade estimate for 2.287 billion and also up from USDA's forecast in September for 2.270 billion.
At 1208 CDT, soybeans were 14-3/4 to 30 cents lower, with November down 29-3/4 at $7.00-1/2 per bushel.
